contract.business_objective: Increase qualified consideration among SME CEOs
contract.scope: Vietnam SME decision makers; design phase

target.primary_segment: SME CEOs who tried isolated tools but lack operational adoption
target.problem: Experiments do not become repeatable workflows with accountable owners
target.occasion: After initial tool trials stall and leadership must choose an implementation partner
target.desired_progress: Move from experiments to governed workflows the internal team can operate
target.exclusion: Buyers seeking only tool tutorials or unmanaged full outsourcing

frame.point_of_difference: Transfers governed workflows and operating capability instead of leaving isolated demos
frame.barrier: Category may be mistaken for another training program

territories.target_occasion: CEO selecting an A.I training provider
territories.problem: leaders lack a common A.I language
territories.difference: learning tied to one live workflow

territories.problem: demos do not become governed operations
territories.promise: turn a priority process into an owned, repeatable workflow
territories.difference: implementation plus capability transfer and control evidence
territories.sacrifice: not tool-only training or black-box outsourcing

position.target: SME CEOs whose isolated A.I experiments have stalled
position.problem: Demos fail to become governed workflows with internal ownership
position.promise: Convert one priority process into an owned, repeatable workflow
position.difference: Combines implementation, operating controls and capability transfer
position.sacrifice: Not tool-only training and not black-box outsourcing
position.statement: For SME CEOs whose experiments have stalled, the offer is a capability-transfer implementation partnership that converts a priority process into an owned, governed workflow, supported by delivery evidence and operator transfer.
position.memory_hook: From stalled experiments to owned workflows

claims.text: The target reports stalled adoption after initial experiments
claims.limitations: Applies to the interviewed SME segment

claims.text: The delivery model includes workflow implementation and operator transfer
claims.limitations: Applies to the documented delivery scope

claims.text: Capability transfer is less visible in audited alternative messaging
claims.limitations: Dated message audit; not a claim about full competitor capability
